identity_reconciliation.reason: Deferred deliberately, not skipped. Reconciling 110 real 2024 FBS names to a 2026 canonical universe would produce a mapping that looks complete and is not meaningful: the canonical universe is the project's synthetic 2026 FBS, which includes conferences and members that do not exist in the real 2024 season, and excludes real 2024 members. A high match rate between the two would be an artifact of shared school names, not evidence that the same entities are being compared. Producing that mapping would make an inadmissible corpus look one step closer to admissible.
identity_reconciliation.design_recorded: The deterministic design is specified in docs/v3_calibration_evidence_lane.md and enforced by calibration_evidence.IdentityReconciliation, which refuses an incomplete mapping rather than dropping unresolved names.

integrity_findings.detail: game_id T073vT114 appears twice in the 2024-2025 stream. The scheme is team-pair keyed (T<a>vT<b>), so a repeated matchup collides. The two rows are Oregon State 16-24 Washington State (week 0, SYNTH_BLOCK, no date) and Oregon State 41-38 Washington State (week 13, REAL, 2024-11-24).
integrity_findings.contract_clause: game_id: 'Must be unique within the dataset and stable across re-ingestion.'
integrity_findings.disposition: Reported, not repaired. Repairing a key inside an inadmissible corpus would be work spent making a refused source look conforming.

blocked_on_unratified_transform.finding: Even a perfect observation corpus would not yield expected_margin today.
blocked_on_unratified_transform.detail: The contract requires expected_margin in V3 point units together with a named rating-to-margin transform, because otherwise weekly_performance_residual_coefficient is unidentifiable: any residual can be absorbed by rescaling the transform. V3 carries no such ratified transform. sor.py records P_TO_STRENGTH_TRANSFORM and REFERENCE_HFA as unratified, and all six calibration values in config/dynamic_weekly_mc_v3/v3_experimental.json remain null.
blocked_on_unratified_transform.consequence: Source data is a necessary condition for this lane, not a sufficient one. A future lane that mounts a conforming corpus will still be blocked on the transform ruling.

evidence: All 1481 rows of the 2024-2025 stream are FBS-vs-FBS; synthetic_division_a and synthetic_division_b are FBS on every row.
The 550 real 2024 observations contain no FCS opponent.
The 2006-2011 corpus contains 69 games involving an FCS side, but 63 of those fall in 2011 alone and the whole corpus is refused as synthetic and research-only.
fcs_scale_findings.conclusion: Insufficient evidence. There is no set of observed FBS-vs-FCS games from which to estimate an FCS representation on the unified point axis.

experiments.reason: Phase 7 is gated on Phases 1-6 producing an admissible dataset. They did not.

game_sd_findings.observation: The signed margin standard deviation of the 550 real 2024 FBS observations is 19.764 points.
game_sd_findings.why_this_is_not_evidence_for_game_sd_poi: That is the unconditional dispersion of outcomes, not the dispersion of a model's residuals. A pregame model that explains any strength difference at all must produce a residual SD below it. The figure therefore bounds game_sd_points from above under this corpus and does nothing to locate it, and the corpus is in any case one season short of three and 950 observations short of the floor. Its proximity to the recorded 20.2 is not a corroboration of 20.2; open item ENG-CAL-MARGIN is untouched.

harness_changes.weakness_reproduced_before_fixing: A CalibrationDataset constructed by hand, citing a path that was never written and a digest of 00*32, binds successfully through calibration.bind_promotion_evidence and returns evidence_bound True. The probe is retained as the first test in the new file so the fix is anchored to a demonstrated defect.
harness_changes.fix: Every gate on the new path re-derives evidence from bytes at binding time: the mount receipt is re-read and re-hashed, and the dataset is re-registered from disk so schema, row count, allowlist, duplicate-column, ragged-row and forbidden-signal checks all run against the bytes present now.
harness_changes.minimum_volume_note: The contract stated the four minimums and nothing refused a corpus that failed them. require_minimum_volume now does, and is a required step in envelope assembly.
harness_changes.strongest_possible_output: EVIDENCE_BOUND_BYTES_REVERIFIED_AT_BINDING, which reports promotion_authorised false and writes_canonical_config false.
harness_changes.existing_r2_path_note: calibration.bind_promotion_evidence was not tightened. This lane has no authority to narrow ruling R2-CAL-OBJECTIVE, so the weaker path keeps its behaviour and its EVIDENCE_UNBOUND stamp; the stronger path is additive.

to_unblock: Supply a real-world game-result corpus covering at least three seasons, at least 1500 observations, at least 300 in the holdout, and at least 8 games per team per season, with kickoff instants.

Or issue a ruling that defines a governed synthetic-universe observation authority and states explicitly that the contract's synthetic_content refusal does not reach it. This lane cannot make that ruling and did not assume it. It is the single decision that would convert roughly 4,600 locally available games from refused to reviewable.
Ratify the rating-to-margin transform (P_TO_STRENGTH_TRANSFORM) and REFERENCE_HFA, without which expected_margin cannot be constructed in V3 units.
Rule on the four fields awaiting admission, with the availability evidence in data_contract_status.REQUESTED_BUT_NOT_GOVERNED in front of the decision.

provenance_class.FACT: Byte-level properties of files opened in this environment: digests, row counts, column sets, value distributions, and text quoted verbatim from the sources' own control documents.
provenance_class.DERIVED: Counts and statistics computed from those bytes, and the contract-field classification.
provenance_class.ASSUMPTION: None recorded. Where a judgement was required — whether a project-synthetic universe may serve as a governed observation authority — it is raised as a ruling request rather than resolved.
